name: hy-skills
description: Personal methodology skills for AI-assisted development. Ships go, my-simplify, refactor, open-worktree, commit-push-pr, loop-for-merge, close-worktree, prototype-board, goal-shaper, gdd, grilling, explain, html-as-doc, infisical-secrets, use-portless. Same skills run under Claude Code, Codex, and any skill-only agent.

interface.shortDescription: Worktree workflow, feature delivery, goal shaping, env staging, and Portless dev URLs
interface.longDescription: Personal methodology skills grown from day-to-day practice using AI across many codebases and products. Covers task kickoff (open-worktree), feature implementation with light TDD (go), fallback simplification review when native Simplify is unavailable (my-simplify), friction-driven maintainability and architecture-coherence refactor audits (refactor), branch publishing (commit-push-pr), happy-path PR watching (loop-for-merge), post-merge cleanup (close-worktree), feel-first interactive prototype boards for validating UX before implementation (prototype-board), section-by-section milestone goal shaping before agents start implementation (goal-shaper), goal-driven development that shapes goals from backlog candidates through a drafting gate (gdd), relentless one-question-at-a-time interviewing to stress-test a plan or design before building (grilling), user-tailored explanations across question types with a consistent expression discipline (explain), rendering converged content as single-file self-contained HTML docs under an apple.com-inspired design discipline (html-as-doc), explicit Infisical secret discovery for local agent/model-provider env files (infisical-secrets), and Portless-backed local dev server URLs for previews, APIs, OAuth/MCP callbacks, mobile/LAN checks, and browser verification (use-portless). Same skill files run under Claude Code plugins, Codex plugins, and plain skill-only agents.
defaultPrompt: Open a worktree for a new task.
Implement this feature end-to-end and let me try it.
Shape this milestone into an agent-executable GOAL.md.
Start this dev server with a stable Portless URL.
